'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukraine War]]
***The [[United States]] announces a new [[military aid]] package to [[Ukraine]], including [[missile defense|air defense missiles]], munitions for [[M142 HIMARS|High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems (HIMARS)]], an array of [[anti-tank guided missiles|anti-armor missiles]], vehicles, and other equipment. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-military-aid-us-kursk-4ca7ba2bb2da155d8038c0376da80ab1 (AP)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] launches over 100 rocket strikes on [[Israel Defense Forces]] targets in [[Mount Meron]] and [[Al-Malkiyya]] that were intercepted by [[Iron Dome]] and caused [[wildfire]]s. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-6-hezbollah-members-killed-in-idf-strikes-as-projectiles-fired-at-north/ (''Times of Israel'')] 
**Seven Hezbollah militants are killed in [[Israel]]i airstrikes and [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] on [[Tayr Harfa]] and [[Shebaa]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-6-hezbollah-members-killed-in-idf-strikes-as-projectiles-fired-at-north/ (''Times of Israel'')] 
*[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]], [[Turkish war crimes]]
**Three people, including two journalists, are killed and another journalist is injured in a [[Turkish Armed Forces|Turkish]] [[drone strike]] on a vehicle in [[Sulaymaniyah]] in the [[Kurdistan Region]] of [[Iraq]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/23/authorities-in-northern-iraq-report-casualties-from-turkish-drone-strike (Al Jazeera)] [https://cpj.org/2024/08/two-media-workers-killed-1-injured-in-drone-strike-in-iraqi-kurdistan/ (Committee to Protect Journalists)]
*[[Surovikino penal colony hostage crisis]]
**Four inmates linked to the [[Islamic State]] seize control of a prison in [[Surovikino]], [[Volgograd Oblast]], [[Russia]], and take [[hostage]]s, killing four prison staff members and injuring three others. The attackers are shot dead by responding [[Federal Security Services|security forces]]. [https://en.apa.az/cis-countries/isis-members-killed-3-employees-of-penal-colony-and-took-several-people-hostage-in-volgograd-updated-446047 (Azerbaijani Press Agency)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/23/knife-wielding-russian-convicts-take-prison-staff-hostage-and-kill-one-guard (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Abu Abdul Rahman Makki, a senior leader of the [[al-Qaeda]]-linked [[Hurras al-Din]], is killed by an [[airstrike]] in [[Jabal Zawiya]], [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-drone-strike-militant-idlib-73f715bc10ba0135eaba5eca795609f4 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Unemployment in the United States]]
**[[United States]] [[Chair of the Federal Reserve]] [[Jerome Powell]] states that increased [[unemployment]] rates and [[Labour economics|labor market cooling]] has made it necessary for the [[Federal Reserve]] to markedly reduce [[interest rate]]s in the near future. [https://www.reuters.com/business/jackson-hole-live-fed-chair-jerome-powell-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 India–Bangladesh floods]] 
**At least 23 people are killed and more than 4.5 million people are affected by [[flood]]s caused by heavy rains in eastern [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/23/hundreds-of-thousands-stranded-as-floods-hit-india-and-bangladesh (Al Jazeera)]
*Twenty-seven people are killed and 16 more injured when a bus carrying [[India]]n [[pilgrim]]s on the [[Prithvi Highway]] in [[Nepal]] [[traffic collision|crashes]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-bus-accident-indian-pilgrims-marsyangdi-f183559f47ed82447bdc899ea44c2ce6 (AP)]
*Ten people are killed by [[landslide]]s and [[flood]]ing in [[Phuket]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2852618/landslides-kill-10-in-phuket (Bangkok Post)]
* A tourist from India falls eight-meters deep into a [[sinkhole]] after a section of a sidewalk along Jalan Masjid India in [[Kuala Lumpur]] caved in, prompting search and rescue operations. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2024/08/23/woman-falls-into-8m-deep-sinkhole-in-kl-sar-op-ongoing (The Star)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/woman-falls-into-8m-deep-sinkhole-in-kuala-lumpur-rescue-operation-under-way (The Straits Times)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2024 mpox epidemic]]
**[[Gabon]] reports its first case of [[mpox]] in a man who traveled to [[Uganda]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/health/article/2024/08/23/gabon-reports-its-first-mpox-case_6720631_14.html (''Le Monde'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Russia–United States relations]], [[China–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Treasury Department]] imposes [[international sanctions|sanctions]] on more than 400 individuals and entities, including [[China|Chinese]] firms that are allegedly aiding [[Russia]] in order to avoid western sanctions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-imposes-sanctions-400-more-targets-aiding-russias-war-effort-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/08/23/politics/us-sanctions-russia/index.html (CNN)] 
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[India–Ukraine relations]]
**During a meeting in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], [[Prime Minister of India]] [[Narendra Modi]] urges [[Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] to end the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]], and volunteers to act as a mediator in talks between Zelenskyy and [[Russia]]. In a later national address, Zelenskyy thanked Modi but stated that it is necessary for India to respect [[international law]] as well as Ukraine's [[territorial integrity]] and [[sovereignty]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/indian-pm-modi-set-visit-kyiv-talks-with-ukraines-zelenskiy-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Poland–South Africa relations]]
**[[South Africa]] blocks the transfer of 50,000 purchased [[artillery]] shells to [[Poland]] out of fear that they would be sent to [[Ukraine]] for use in the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/south-africa-blocks-artillery-shells-delivery-to-poland-due-to-fear-of-transfer-to-ukraine-media-says/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 antisemitic riots in the North Caucasus]]
**A court in [[Krasnodar]], Russia, sentences five men to more than six years in prison for participating in [[Criticism of Israel|anti-Israel]] riots at [[Uytash Airport]] in [[Makhachkala]], [[Dagestan]], in October 2023. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-court-sentences-five-men-anti-israel-riots-dagestan-airport-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Solingen stabbing]]
**Three people are killed and eight others are wounded in a [[mass stabbing]] at a public festival [[Solingen]], [[NRW]], [[Germany]], during celebrations for the 650th anniversary of the city. A [[Manhunt (law enforcement)|manhunt]] for the suspect and a citywide [[shelter-in-place]] emergency for residents are ongoing. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-knife-attack-solingen-festival-84ad7df23ca5ecc8c2145d57e75090d6?utm_source=RecoReel&utm_medium=articlePage&utm_id=Taboola (AP)]
*[[2024 United Kingdom riots]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination]] recommends that the [[United Kingdom]] implement bans and auditing of [[hate speech]], [[Xenophobia|xenophobia]], and [[Far-right politics in the United Kingdom|far-right]] [[rhetoric]] by politicians, in addition to prohibiting the [[strip-search]]ing of children and addressing the over-policing of schools, following widespread destructive [[Opposition to immigration|anti-immigration protests]] exacerbated by remarks made by public figures and politicians. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/curb-hate-speech-after-riots-un-committee-urges-britain-2024-08-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/article/2024/aug/23/un-urges-uk-to-tackle-rise-in-racist-hate-speech-by-politicans-and-public-figures (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Hellenic Coast Guard]] open fire against a [[motorboat]] carrying 14 migrants near the island of [[Symi]], [[Greece]], killing one of the passengers. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-migrants-smuggling-boat-gunfire-death-symi-5675499b37fc38c572547f6748443649 (AP)]
